description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Vedalken Infuser.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, each Vedalken Infuser triggers, putting three charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter and three charge counters on any artifact(s).
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.
